note: A BAG_IF_ELSE node is created with its optimization reference counter initialized from the parsed regex input.
Each recursive visit to the same BAG_MEMORY node increments the shared counter while traversing the regex AST.

The safety obligation is that repeated optimization visits must stop before the shared node is over-referenced; once this bound is exceeded, the optimizer falls back to a coarse length range instead of reusing the same node state.
The AST node body is recursively freed, so later optimizer recursion can encounter freed substructure if the node graph is reused incorrectly.
The optimizer dereferences and updates the shared BAG node state again during recursive traversal, which is the invalid repeated access that manifests as a heap-use-after-free in optimize_nodes.
